name: Reikai
source:
It's up to the person to decide what is most important and what is most correct.
Therefore, even if you suffer from heart-wrenching guilt and regret, you have to stick to what you believe.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/18262]official site[/url]]
translation:
由人来决定什么是最重要的、什么是最正确的。
因此，即使你承受着撕心裂肺的愧疚和悔恨，你也要坚持你所相信的。

[翻译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/18262]官方网站[/url]]
